body: From the DM-272 review (orchestrator, this run): (1) deadcode: src/test/scorecardWorldRecorder.ts:30 imports src/renderer/src/scorecard/scoreReads.ts, pulling it into the tsconfig.node.json run, so 24 renderer-only exports read as dead; 4 more are `export`s used only in-module (scorecardWorldRecorder.ts:36,43,49; __mocks__/scorecardWorlds.ts:49) — drop those exports and baseline knowingly (the baseline key has no project). (2) scorecardWorldRecorder.test.ts compares shapes only; since the recorder is byte-deterministic, compare fresh to stored with toEqual. (3) unpinned: epicScorecardView.ts:420 missing-with-number, MetricsDashboard.tsx:47 error hidden while refreshing. (4) __mocks__/scorecardWorlds.ts:53 reads relative to cwd — use the module URL. (5) Mark __mocks__/scorecardWorlds/ linguist-generated in .gitattributes. Also: src/core/repo/scorecardPortability.test.ts has 25 empty tests by Fireguard's AST rule (see DM-198 comment).
